name: AutoShark SharkMinter mints on donated balances (May 2021)
summary: SharkMinter.mintFor, a PancakeBunny-style minter, zaps its whole LP, SHARK and WBNB balance (balanceOf(this)) into SHARK-BNB liquidity and mints SHARK in proportion to that value, so donated tokens inflate the reward. The attacker sent flash-borrowed WBNB and SHARK to the minter, claimed a tiny vault reward that minted a huge SHARK amount, and sold it.
notes: The reset is SharkMinter.setMinter(vault, true), the last of the owner's wiring txs (SHARK ownership to the minter, vault setMinter, minter whitelist). mintFor is onlyMinter, so the exploit needed this grant (rule 10); setSharkPerProfitBNB only sizes the mint.
Loss is the depletion of the SHARK/WBNB and SHARK/BUSD pairs that bought the unbacked mint; the SHARK they received is not subtracted and the flash-loan pair was repaid.
